{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for converted orders (converted = 1)
converted = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99)
# and refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
# But note: the contract says to exclude QA orders AND refunded orders
# So we exclude any order that is either a QA order OR refunded
excluded = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99) | (df['status'] == 'refunded')

# Apply filters: only converted orders, not excluded
eligible = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & ~excluded]

# Calculate average revenue per converted order
avg_revenue = eligible['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output
print(f'Number of converted orders: {len(converted)}')
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(df[df["revenue_clean"] == 999999.99])}')
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(df[df["status"] == "refunded"])}')
print(f'Number of excluded orders (QA or refunded): {excluded.sum()}')
print(f'Number of eligible converted orders: {len(eligible)}')
print(f'Average revenue per eligible converted order: {avg_revenue:.2f}')"}
